findings.location: Product grid (book items in all rows)
findings.issue: Vertical misalignment of star ratings, book titles, and prices within the rows. Because the book cover images have varying aspect ratios and heights and are not placed in a fixed-height container, all elements below the images are pushed down to different vertical positions, creating an uneven and jagged layout.
findings.user_impact: Creates visual clutter and makes scanning prices, star ratings, and titles across different products in the same row difficult for users.
findings.recommendation: Enclose the book cover images in a container with a fixed height (e.g., 220px) and use flexbox alignment ('display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;') to center the covers. This ensures all stars, titles, and prices align horizontally across each row.

findings.issue: The light blue link text of the non-selected categories (e.g., 'Mystery', 'Historical Fiction', etc.) fails WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 when placed against the very light grey background panel (#f7f7f7).
findings.user_impact: Users with moderate visual impairments or those viewing the site on lower quality displays/bright lighting will find it difficult to read and navigate the book categories.
findings.recommendation: Change the category link text color to a darker, more saturated blue (such as #1c588c) or a dark slate grey to ensure the contrast ratio meets or exceeds the WCAG AA 4.5:1 requirement against the light grey sidebar background.

findings.location: Warning alert banner at the top of the main content area
findings.issue: The warning text ('Warning! This is a demo website...') is styled in a medium brown/gold shade on a pale yellow background box. This color combination yields a contrast ratio below the WCAG AA threshold of 4.5:1 for standard body text.
findings.user_impact: Important notice/warning information is poorly legible, increasing the chance that users will overlook this message.
findings.recommendation: Darken the warning text color to a deep brown (such as #664d03) to ensure a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 on the pale yellow (#fcf8e3) background container.
